About this home

521 E Gilmour is a custom estate in the Heritage Farms subdivision of Grantsville, built by Heritage Homes and shown as Home #29 in the 2026 Salt Lake Parade of Homes.

It has seven bedrooms and five bathrooms, and includes a separate-entrance basement apartment — a space that can be used as an income suite. Ask us for current rental comparables if that income potential matters to you.
